title: Shooting Our Songs
subtitle: Berlin, Brandenburg
content: In spring, we shot 'Our Songs' in Berlin and along the Elbe in Brandenburg together with Mauritz Strauf, Mo G. Beiküfner, Annika Kuhl, Leyla Emilia Zeh, Natascha Bondar and many other wonderful cast members. After a close collaboration on research and script development with DoP Terry Kraatz and Aljoscha Wuzella we worked on a cross-disciplinary visual language together with musician Mo G. Beiküfner, production designer Martha Inés Brenner, costume designer Franziska Weil, sound supervisor Timo Kleinemeier and editor Frederik Bösing.
